profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is SV Colo, formally Silicon Valley Colocation Inc, a privately owned colocation data center provider headquartered in Santa Clara, California. According to the company own history, it began in 1994 as an internet service provider called Meer.net, leased its first colocation space in Sunnyvale in 2002, and relocated to its current main Santa Clara facility in 2004. SV Colo describes itself as owned and managed by its principals rather than outside institutional investors, distinguishing it from large REIT backed colocation providers also present in the Santa Clara market, such as CoreSite and Colovore. The company offers colocation cabinets, cages, and custom suites, critical power and cooling infrastructure, carrier neutral connectivity, remote hands support, and SSAE 16 and PCI compliant operations. No published critical IT megawattage figure was found on SV Colo own site. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
